title: Contextual Nudge Tiles — Compact Checklist & Tips Carousel for Initial Console Launch
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a lightweight, horizontally-scrollable 'nudge tile' component and a complementary compact checklist for the console's first-time launch experience. Goal: reduce cognitive load, encourage key setup steps (API key, model selection, quick test), and provide microtips based on user signals. Deliverables: tile art assets, compressed screenshot set for docs, animation spec for carousel swipe and reveal states, and a checklist component that collapses to a mini summary.
acceptance_criteria: Tile component has 6 distinct states: onboarding-default, success, warning, loading, collapsed, expired
Figma frames exported at 2x and 3x for web and retina screens, PNG + SVG variants
Checklist supports progress tracking and a single CTA per item; collapses to 1-line summary when complete
Animation spec includes duration, easing, and 3 breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop)
Assets included in a screenshots pack with accessible alt text and copy snippets for docs team
Hand-off notes include tokenized copy strings, color tokens, and accessible contrast checks
design_notes: Use a condensed visual language — single accent color per tile tied to step category (security, config, test)
Trade-off: heavier illustrations vs. faster perceived load. Chosen approach: simplified glyphs + subtle texture to keep bundle small
Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast on actionable text; icons have aria-hidden with descriptive alt text on tiles
Behavior: tiles auto-skip on previously completed steps for returning users; retention controlled by account-level metadata rather than local storage
Performance: provide static fallback image for environments where animation/JS is disabled
